lines.lyric_translation: Every day it rings, the bell bell bell
Now care for me
I don’t wanna waste my battery
It keeps coming, it keeps coming
Like my phone’s gonna explode
I don’t know, I don’t know, he says he can’t even breathe
He says he’s struggling because of me
He says his heart is dropping, why?

lines.lyric_hangul: 왜 걔 말은 나 너무 예쁘대?
lines.lyric_translation: He says that I’m so pretty
I’m not showing off or anything
Sorry I couldn’t pick up earlier
I was meeting my friends, shy shy shy
I can’t really meet you right now, sorry
I’ll call you a little later
Don’t beg, then you won’t last long
I’ll let you call me baby

lines.lyric: Ajigeun jom illeo naemam gatgin illeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 아직은 좀 일러, 내 맘 갖긴 일러
lines.lyric_translation: It’s still a little too early, too early for my heart
To feel the same, but I’ll show you more

lines.lyric_hangul: Cheer up, baby Cheer up, baby, 좀 더 힘을 내
lines.lyric_translation: Cheer up baby, cheer up baby / Cheer up a little more

parts.lyric: Cheer up baby, cheer up baby

lines.lyric_hangul: 여자가 쉽게 맘을 주면 안 돼
lines.lyric_translation: A girl can’t give her heart too easily

lines.lyric: Geuraeya niga nal deo joahage dwelkkeol
lines.lyric_hangul: 그래야 네가 날 더 좋아하게 될걸
lines.lyric_translation: That’s how you’ll get to like me even more
I’ll act calm, as if it’s nothing
So you won’t know that I like you
Just get it together

lines.lyric_hangul: And then baby, cheer up (I need you)
lines.lyric_translation: And then baby cheer up
I can hear the anxiety in your voice
I can see the sweat forming on your phone

lines.lyric: Baro baro daedapaneun geotto maeryeok eopseo
lines.lyric_translation: It’s not attractive to answer right away

lines.lyric: Meshijiman ilkko hwagin an haneun geon gibon
lines.lyric_hangul: 메시지만 읽고 확인 안 하는 건 기본
lines.lyric_translation: Reading your text and not responding is a given
Oops, was I too harsh boy?
I’m worried that you’ll get tired
But if not, I think I’ll fall for you

lines.lyric: Ppajil kkeonman gateo ppajil kkeonman gateo
lines.lyric_hangul: 빠질 것만 같어, 빠질 것만 같어
lines.lyric_translation: I think I’ll fall you for even more
Sorry I couldn’t respond
I was meeting my friends, shy shy shy
I can’t really meet you right now, sorry
I’ll call you a little later
Don’t beg, I’m not going anywhere
I’ll be your baby

lines.lyric: Neomu ppallin shireo seongereul deo boyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 너무 빨린 싫어, 성의를 더 보여
lines.lyric_translation: But not too fast, show me you mean it
I’ll wait for you

lines.lyric: Nado niga joa sangcheo ibeulkka bwa
lines.lyric_hangul: 나도 네가 좋아, 상처 입을까 봐
lines.lyric_translation: I like you too, I’m just worried I’ll get hurt
I hope you understand cuz I’m a girl
I’m scared that you’ll find out how I feel
Come to me little by little just like now
It won’t take that long
Just get it together
And then baby cheer up
